statement: A gateway forwards the request it decided: `PipelineGatewayFilter` removes the method-override headers `X-HTTP-Method-Override`, `X-HTTP-Method` and `X-Method-Override`, in any letter case, from every request it forwards, on every route, whether or not the route receives the identity, so a backend never runs a request as another method than the one the gateway decided (a DENY on `http:DELETE` is not stepped around by a `POST` that carries one of them). Not configurable. Every other header is forwarded as before. In-process hosts decide after Spring's hidden-method filter (`PIP-19`), and a service behind the gateway runs none (`STA-6`).
